description: The Form 4 is a resin (masked stereolithography) 3D printer. It uses 405 nm light to harden liquid photopolymer resin layer by layer. In a makerspace it makes detailed, smooth prototypes, snap-fit assemblies, small enclosures, jigs and molds. Resin comes from cartridges and is filled into the tank automatically. Finished parts must be washed in IPA and then UV post-cured.

specs.label: Light source
specs.value: 405 nm LED backlight with LCD mask

materials: Formlabs photopolymer resins (general purpose, tough, rigid, flexible/elastic, silicone, high-temperature, flame-retardant, castable, ceramic)
Third-party 405 nm photopolymer resins via Open Material Mode
useRestrictions: Users must complete training before printing, use only resins the lab has approved, and wash parts in IPA only in a ventilated area.
